
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/haof31/p/19274843" title="发布于 2025-11-26 22:31">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【Java】线程池源码解析</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>点进ThreadPoolExectutor源码ThreadPoolExecutor.java可以看到线程池的核心实现；</p>
<h2 id="threadpoolexecutor">ThreadPoolExecutor</h2>
<p>首先是<code>ThreadPoolExecutor()</code>里面可以看到线程池核心参数</p>
<pre><code class="language-Java">public ThreadPoolExecutor(int corePoolSize,
                          int maximumPoolSize,
                          long keepAliveTime,
                          TimeUnit unit,
                          BlockingQueue&lt;Runnable&gt; workQueue,
                          ThreadFactory threadFactory,
                          RejectedExecutionHandler handler) {
    if (corePoolSize &lt; 0 ||
        maximumPoolSize &lt;= 0 ||
        maximumPoolSize &lt; corePoolSize ||
        keepAliveTime &lt; 0)
        throw new IllegalArgumentException();
    if (workQueue == null || threadFactory == null || handler == null)
        throw new NullPointerException();
    this.acc = System.getSecurityManager() == null ?
            null :
            AccessController.getContext();
    this.corePoolSize = corePoolSize;
    this.maximumPoolSize = maximumPoolSize;
    this.workQueue = workQueue;
    this.keepAliveTime = unit.toNanos(keepAliveTime);
    this.threadFactory = threadFactory;
    this.handler = handler;
}
</code></pre>
<p>我们首先看下<code>BlockingQueue&lt;Runnable&gt; workQueue</code>点进去看下，发现是</p>
<p><code>private final BlockingQueue&lt;Runnable&gt; workQueue;</code>队列中存放的是Runnable对象，即可执行对象</p>
<p>还有一个在核心参数中没有体现的：</p>
<p><code>private final HashSet&lt;Worker&gt; workers = new HashSet&lt;Worker&gt;();</code></p>
<h2 id="worker">Worker</h2>
<p>这个用存放Worker对象的HashSet其实就是线程池，点Worker进去看下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">private final class Worker
    extends AbstractQueuedSynchronizer
    implements Runnable
{
    // 省略部分方法和变量
    /** Thread this worker is running in.  Null if factory fails. */
    final Thread thread;
    /** Initial task to run.  Possibly null. */
    Runnable firstTask;
    Worker(Runnable firstTask) {
        setState(-1); // inhibit interrupts until runWorker
        this.firstTask = firstTask;
        this.thread = getThreadFactory().newThread(this);
    }

    /** Delegates main run loop to outer runWorker  */
    public void run() {
        runWorker(this);
    }  
 }
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><code>HashSet</code><strong><strong>不是</strong></strong>线程安全****的</strong>。</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>所以在源码中，凡是涉及对 <code>workers</code> 进行 add（添加线程）或 remove（销毁线程）操作时，都需要获取一把全局锁：<code>mainLock</code>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>这也是为什么在高并发场景下，频繁创建/销毁线程会影响性能的原因之一（因为要争抢 <code>mainLock</code>）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>worker是</strong> <strong><code>extends AQS</code></strong></p>
<p>思考题： 为什么 <code>Worker</code> 要继承 <code>AQS</code>（实现锁的功能）？它不是已经有 <code>runWorker</code> 在跑了吗？</p>
<p>答案：</p>
<p>Worker 自己实现了一把不可重入锁。</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>作用：为了区分**“线程是在空闲（等任务）”** 还是 “正在干活（跑任务）”。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>在 <code>runWorker</code> 里：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>w.lock()</code>：开始执行任务前加锁。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>w.unlock()</code>：任务执行完解锁。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>场景：当你想调用 <code>shutdown()</code> 关闭线程池时，线程池会去中断那些没有被锁住（即没有在干活）的线程。如果一个线程正在干活（持有锁），<code>shutdown</code> 就不会中断它，让它把活干完。只有 <code>shutdownNow</code> 才会不管三七二十一去中断正在干活的线程。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>可以发现有个重要成员变量：<code>firstTask</code>，这个表明要被执行的任务</p>
<p>看下构造函数：</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">Worker(Runnable firstTask) {
    setState(-1); // inhibit interrupts until runWorker
    this.firstTask = firstTask;
    this.thread = getThreadFactory().newThread(this);
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>this.thread = getThreadFactory().newThread(this);</code>这里的newThread()参数是this,也就是<code>Worker</code>本身，当创建 <code>Worker</code> 时，它通过线程工厂创建了一个 Java <code>Thread</code> 对象。</p>
<p>还有个run方法<code>public void run() {runWorker(this);}</code></p>
<h2 id="runworker">runWorker()</h2>
<p>run方法中执行的是<code>runWorker()</code>方法,参数是this，点进去看下</p>
<pre><code class="language-Java">final void runWorker(Worker w) {
    Thread wt = Thread.currentThread();
    Runnable task = w.firstTask;
    w.firstTask = null;
    w.unlock(); // allow interrupts
    boolean completedAbruptly = true;
    try {
        while (task != null || (task = getTask()) != null) {
            w.lock();
            // If pool is stopping, ensure thread is interrupted;
            // if not, ensure thread is not interrupted.  This
            // requires a recheck in second case to deal with
            // shutdownNow race while clearing interrupt
            if ((runStateAtLeast(ctl.get(), STOP) ||
                 (Thread.interrupted() &amp;&amp;
                  runStateAtLeast(ctl.get(), STOP))) &amp;&amp;
                !wt.isInterrupted())
                wt.interrupt();
            try {
                beforeExecute(wt, task);
                Throwable thrown = null;
                try {
                    task.run();
                } catch (RuntimeException x) {
                    thrown = x; throw x;
                } catch (Error x) {
                    thrown = x; throw x;
                } catch (Throwable x) {
                    thrown = x; throw new Error(x);
                } finally {
                    afterExecute(task, thrown);
                }
            } finally {
                task = null;
                w.completedTasks++;
                w.unlock();
            }
        }
        completedAbruptly = false;
    } finally {
        processWorkerExit(w, completedAbruptly);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>可以看出里面一个大的while循环，循环条件是<code>task != null || (task = getTask()) != null</code>这就是线程池的<strong>线程复用</strong>的关键！当任务不为空或者能获取到任务时，线程池都在工作。</p>
<h2 id="gettask">getTask()</h2>
<p>这个getTask()方法也可以看下</p>
<pre><code class="language-Java">private Runnable getTask() {
    boolean timedOut = false; // Did the last poll() time out?

    for (;;) {
        int c = ctl.get();
        int rs = runStateOf(c);

        // Check if queue empty only if necessary.
        if (rs &gt;= SHUTDOWN &amp;&amp; (rs &gt;= STOP || workQueue.isEmpty())) {
            decrementWorkerCount();
            return null;
        }

        int wc = workerCountOf(c);

        // Are workers subject to culling?
        boolean timed = allowCoreThreadTimeOut || wc &gt; corePoolSize;

        if ((wc &gt; maximumPoolSize || (timed &amp;&amp; timedOut))
            &amp;&amp; (wc &gt; 1 || workQueue.isEmpty())) {
            if (compareAndDecrementWorkerCount(c))
                return null;
            continue;
        }

        try {
            Runnable r = timed ?
                workQueue.poll(keepAliveTime, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS) :
                workQueue.take();
            if (r != null)
                return r;
            timedOut = true;
        } catch (InterruptedException retry) {
            timedOut = false;
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>wc记录的是工作线程数，<code>timed</code> 标记的是<strong>“当前这个线程是否受超时限制”</strong>。</p>
<p>再看下里面try内逻辑：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>如果 <code>timed == true</code>（通常是因为 <code>wc &gt; corePoolSize</code>），说明当前线程属于“多出来的非核心线程”。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>那么它去队列拿任务时，用 <code>poll(keepAliveTime)</code>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>关键点：如果在 <code>keepAliveTime</code> 时间内没拿到任务（返回 null），下一次循环时 <code>timedOut</code> 就会变为 <code>true</code>，进而导致返回 <code>null</code>，最终导致这个 Worker 退出循环被销毁。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>总结：是先“等待超时拿到 null”，然后才“被回收”。</p>
<h2 id="execute">execute()</h2>
<p>再看下execute()方法</p>
<pre><code class="language-Java">public void execute(Runnable command) {
    if (command == null)
        throw new NullPointerException();
    /*
     * Proceed in 3 steps:
     *
     * 1. If fewer than corePoolSize threads are running, try to
     * start a new thread with the given command as its first
     * task.  The call to addWorker atomically checks runState and
     * workerCount, and so prevents false alarms that would add
     * threads when it shouldn't, by returning false.
     *
     * 2. If a task can be successfully queued, then we still need
     * to double-check whether we should have added a thread
     * (because existing ones died since last checking) or that
     * the pool shut down since entry into this method. So we
     * recheck state and if necessary roll back the enqueuing if
     * stopped, or start a new thread if there are none.
     *
     * 3. If we cannot queue task, then we try to add a new
     * thread.  If it fails, we know we are shut down or saturated
     * and so reject the task.
     */
    int c = ctl.get();
    if (workerCountOf(c) &lt; corePoolSize) {
        if (addWorker(command, true))
            return;
        c = ctl.get();
    }
    if (isRunning(c) &amp;&amp; workQueue.offer(command)) {
        int recheck = ctl.get();
        if (! isRunning(recheck) &amp;&amp; remove(command))
            reject(command);
        else if (workerCountOf(recheck) == 0)
            addWorker(null, false);
    }
    else if (!addWorker(command, false))
        reject(command);
}
</code></pre>
<p>无论是看注释还是看if-else那块代码都能理解：</p>
<p>如果任务数小于核心线程数，那就创建核心线程</p>
<p>如果线程池正在运行，尝试将任务加入队列（workQueue.offer(command)）</p>
<p>成功后需要二次检查：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>如果线程池已关闭，移除任务并拒绝</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>如果没有线程了，创建新线程</p>
</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>你可能会疑惑，为什么任务已经入队了，还要判断 <code>workerCount == 0</code> 并可能创建一个空任务线程？</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>原因：假设核心线程数（Core）设为 0，或者在任务入队的瞬间，现有的线程刚好都挂了（抛异常）或者都超时销毁了。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>后果：如果这里不检查，任务孤零零地躺在队列里，永远没人去取它，导致“死锁”般的假死状态。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>作用：兜底策略，确保只要队列里有任务，就至少有一个线程活着去处理它。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>如果队列满了</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>尝试创建非核心线程（addWorker(command, false)）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>如果失败（达到最大线程数），拒绝任务</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>再关注一下另外两个的重要的方法；</p>
<h2 id="prestartcorethread">prestartCoreThread()</h2>
<pre><code class="language-Java">/**
 * Starts a core thread, causing it to idly wait for work. This
 * overrides the default policy of starting core threads only when
 * new tasks are executed. This method will return {@code false}
 * if all core threads have already been started.
 *
 * @return {@code true} if a thread was started
 */
public boolean prestartCoreThread() {
    return workerCountOf(ctl.get()) &lt; corePoolSize &amp;&amp;
        addWorker(null, true);
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="prestartallcorethreads">prestartAllCoreThreads()</h2>
<pre><code class="language-Java">/**
 * Starts all core threads, causing them to idly wait for work. This
 * overrides the default policy of starting core threads only when
 * new tasks are executed.
 *
 * @return the number of threads started
 */
public int prestartAllCoreThreads() {
    int n = 0;
    while (addWorker(null, true))
        ++n;
    return n;
}
</code></pre>
<ol>
<li>
<h3 id="核心机制addworkernull-true">核心机制：<code>addWorker(null, true)</code></h3>
</li>
</ol>
<p>首先注意到这两个方法内部都调用了：</p>
<p>Java</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">addWorker(null, true)
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>null</code>: 这里的 <code>firstTask</code> 是空。</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>回忆一下之前看的 <code>runWorker</code> 源码：如果 <code>firstTask</code> 为空，线程启动后就不会立即执行任务，而是直接进入 <code>while</code> 循环调用 <code>getTask()</code>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>getTask()</code> 会调用 <code>workQueue.take()</code>，导致该线程在队列上阻塞等待。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>true</code>: 表示创建的是核心线程。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>结论：<code>addWorker(null, true)</code> 的作用就是——招一个工人，让他没事干先去仓库门口等着，随时准备干活。</p>
<hr>
<h3 id="2-prestartcorethread--启动一个">2. <code>prestartCoreThread()</code> —— 启动一个</h3>
<p>Java</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">public boolean prestartCoreThread() {   
     // 1. 检查当前线程数是否小于核心数    
     // 2. 尝试创建一个空任务的核心线程    
     return workerCountOf(ctl.get()) &lt; corePoolSize &amp;&amp; addWorker(null, true);
 }
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>
<p>理解：如果核心线程还没满，就提前启动一个核心线程。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>返回值：如果成功启动了一个线程，返回 true；如果核心线程早已满了，返回 false。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="3-prestartallcorethreads--全部启动">3. <code>prestartAllCoreThreads()</code> —— 全部启动</h3>
<p>Java</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">public int prestartAllCoreThreads() {    
    int n = 0;    
    // 只要 addWorker 返回 true（说明还没满），就一直循环创建    
    while (addWorker(null, true))        
    ++n;    
    return n;
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>
<p>理解：不管现在有多少线程，只要没达到 <code>corePoolSize</code>，就一口气把剩下的坑位全填满，让所有核心线程全部就位待命。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>返回值：返回这次一共新启动了多少个线程。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="典型应用场景">典型应用场景：</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>高并发系统的启动时刻：比如“双11”零点，流量瞬间铺天盖地。如果这时候再去创建线程，线程创建的开销可能会导致系统卡顿（Jitter）。使用 <code>prestartAllCoreThreads()</code> 可以在流量到达前先把线程池填满。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>低延迟敏感系统：为了避免请求第一次处理时的抖动（Latency Spike），提前预热。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="总结">总结</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p>入口：<code>ThreadPoolExecutor</code> 构造参数（配置）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>调度：<code>execute()</code>（决策：是建线程还是入队）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>载体：<code>Worker</code>（封装了 Thread 和 Runnable）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>引擎：<code>runWorker()</code>（死循环：取任务 -&gt; 执行 -&gt; 统计）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>油箱：<code>getTask()</code>（阻塞队列取货，决定线程生死）。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p><em>程池的核心本质：</em></p>
<p><em>线程池__不仅仅是</em> <em><code>new Thread()</code></em> <em>的集合，它更是一个 “生产者-消费者” 模型。</em></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><em>生产者：__<code>execute()</code></em> <em>方法，负责把任务“生产”出来并推送到队列或直接交给工人。</em></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><em>消费者：__<code>Worker</code></em> <em>线程，负责从队列这个“缓冲区”里不断</em> <em><code>getTask()</code></em> <em>并消费。</em></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><em>管理者：__<code>ThreadPoolExecutor</code></em> <em>持有</em> <em><code>ctl</code></em> <em>状态，动态控制工人的数量（招人/裁员）。</em></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="1如果核心线程数设置为0会发生啥">1、如果核心线程数设置为0会发生啥？</h3>
<p><em>当</em> <em><code>corePoolSize = 0</code></em> _时，<strong>线程池__就像一个</strong><strong>“全兼职”</strong>_<em>的机构。</em></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><em>任务来了先尝试进队列。</em></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><em>如果进了队列，必须兜底检查是否有线程活着，如果没有，通过</em> <em><code>addWorker(null, false)</code></em> <em>创建一个临时工（非核心线程）来处理队列里的活。注意这里必须用</em> <em><code>false</code>__，因为核心编制（Core）是0，只能招临时工（Max）。</em></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><em>这个临时工线程在</em> <em><code>keepAliveTime</code></em> _超时后会被销毁，_<em>线程池__最终会变回空状态。</em></p>
</li>
</ol>

</div>
